4 Functions for numerical approximation of gradients and Hessians ¶

You should not usually need to use these functions directly or pass them as arguments. They should be chosen and used by optimizer functions, possibly subject to their configuration options.

  • Direct user interface to default numerical gradient method of new frontends
  • Higher order numerical derivatives
  • Another numerical gradient function
  • Numerical Hessian function
  • A string, yielding the numerical gradient if evaluated
  • Complex step derivatives
